Not cheating. Creatine is one of the most studied supplements out there, it's legal in pretty much every sport, and it's not a drug. It helps with short, hard efforts like heavy sets, and it only works alongside the training, so you still have to do the lifting.

On how much, I don't give amounts for supplements. Check with a doctor or a dietitian for what's right for you, especially if you take any medication or have a health condition. The product label is also worth reading.

Training and food come first. If those are consistent, creatine is a small extra, not a shortcut.
